# Social Smiths

> Social Smiths (socialsmiths.in) is a full-service real estate marketing agency in India and Dubai, based in Mumbai (Ghatkopar West), that works only with real estate and hospitality brands. We provide cinematic property video production, social media management, influencer campaign management and performance marketing for site visits and qualified enquiries, on a monthly retainer or per launch. We shoot pan-India and in Dubai — Mumbai, Pune, Lonavala, Delhi, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Indore, Lucknow, Raipur, Nava Raipur, Coimbatore, Goa and Dubai. The agency is led by Brendan Dsouza — a Mumbai real estate cinematographer and creator behind @shotbybrendan_ (145K+ followers), named Mid-Day's Emerging Real Estate Influencer 2026 — alongside co-founder Prarit Singh.

## What we do
- Real estate marketing agency in India for developers, brokers and hospitality brands, headquartered in Mumbai
- Cinematic property video: walkthroughs, drone, lifestyle films, vertical reels
- Social media management: strategy, content calendars, reels, captions
- Influencer marketing: end-to-end creator campaigns for property launches
- Performance marketing: paid campaigns and lead generation for project launches
- Launch and lead-generation content for new project sales

## Who we serve
- Real estate developers running project launches
- Brokers and channel partners needing ongoing content and reels
- Hospitality brands across India and Dubai

## Where we shoot
- India: Mumbai, Pune, Lonavala, Delhi, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad (Gujarat), Indore, Lucknow, Raipur and Nava Raipur, Coimbatore, Goa
- International: Dubai, UAE

## Recent projects outside Mumbai
- Hyderabad: Stonecraft Group's Woods Shamshabad, a development set around a Miyawaki forest that Stonecraft bills as the world's largest
- Hyderabad: branding podcast for ASBL featuring its MD and creator Ravi Kewalramani (recorded in Mumbai)
- Ahmedabad, Gujarat: Adani Realty's Belrosa at Shantigram
- Coimbatore: G Square's 7 Hills plotted development (pan-India influencer campaign)

## Recognition
- Official Influencer Marketing Partner, Navi Mumbai Mid-Day Hot Property Exhibition (August 2026)
- Team felicitated on stage by the Mayor of Navi Mumbai, Sujata Patil; covered in Mid-Day's special real estate marketing feature, August 22, 2026
- Founder Brendan Dsouza named Mid-Day's Emerging Real Estate Influencer 2026
